recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-12751 unless the Pharmacy WG opens a new issue to change current mapping policy or examples.
issue_request: FHIR-12751 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. The Jira asked to update MedicationStatement for QA guidelines, and the final Pharmacy WG resolution was to make the V5 changes to all Pharmacy resources.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to SVN/Git commit 91e97f34ea371becf4b9f7728e3280a1ea2957ae (@11051), which added RIM and workflow mapping content to pharmacy spreadsheets, added the MedicationStatement category W5 mapping, and updated MedicationStatement examples. MedicationPrescription had already become MedicationRequest in the source path touched by that application.
additional_context: The current build uses active fhir.ini entries for Medication, MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement. The old spreadsheet source was refactored into StructureDefinition XML by 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157, and current source/blame shows the relevant RIM and FiveWs mapping spaces and root mappings survived that conversion. Later W5 cleanup commits changed specific subject mappings but did not remove the pharmacy clinical.medication classification or the MedicationStatement.category FiveWs.class mapping. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later community record changing the FHIR-12751 conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already has RIM and FiveWs mapping declarations for the active pharmacy resources, root W5 clinical.medication mappings for all five active resources, and the MedicationStatement.category W5 FiveWs.class mapping requested by the QA update.
